physiology:
The seat of this code is the gut, the long quiet stretch of intestine that does the sorting nobody sees. Food comes in mixed, the body takes what it can use and lets the rest go, and the whole of you depends on the accuracy of that sift. It is fitting that a card about listening lives here. The intestines are the great discerners. They taste what the mouth could not, far down where there are no words, and they choose what becomes you.

The shadow has its floor in this seat. When the ear narrows and only the heavy frequency gets through, the belly tightens with it. Things stop moving. What should pass through stays, and what should be taken in is not absorbed. Bad news sits in the gut before it sits in the mind. The body has been keeping its own ledger, and the ledger is held below the ribs, in the place that knows before knowing.

The climb is bodily too. Softening, warmth low in the centre, the sense of room. The gut quiets when the listening returns. Hunger comes back honest. What was held too long begins to move. The work the card asks for, that finer grade of hearing, is already happening in you, lower down than any decision. The body has been listening all along. It only asks to be let through.
amino_acid:
Deeper than the organ, this code answers to a single amino acid, Glutamine. Glutamine is the most plentiful amino acid the body carries, and the cells lining the gut feed on it directly. They prefer it above almost anything else. The lining of the intestine, the place where the world is taken in or refused, is built and kept whole on this one molecule.

There is a teaching in that. The wall that decides what comes in and what stays out is fed by the same chemistry over and over. Purification is not a single act. It is something the body is doing constantly, cell by cell, with the same small letter on repeat. The Ring this code belongs to is named for it. To listen well is the same work the gut is already doing, sifting, keeping, releasing, without drama.

The code runs all the way down to this. A discernment that is not a stance but a chemistry, fed quietly, all the time, in the part of you that decides what becomes you.
